title: Not a Favor
style: Pop-soul, unhurried bossa sway in the verses, restrained stereo strings, British female singer with a wide range rising into top notes and stacked hook harmonies, warm bass and crisp understated drums, Arabic-tonal-scale instrumental bridges.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I take the wheel, the chauffeur takes the back
He rides beside me, small talk down the track
My room's a wardrobe, work is in his suite
We plan the numbers, line by line, complete

[Pre-Chorus]
Done with the bank's quick, nervous game
Slow capital's the work I came to claim

[Chorus]
Not a favor, not a boss, not a yes
Slow money, clean hands, nothing less
Who holds the power, who holds the purse
I write the terms, for better or worse

[Verse 2]
I carry the numbers, he carries the view
Closed doors, old friends, and the fear comes through
The more he holds, the less I'm free
The less he holds, the more it's me

[Pre-Chorus]
My name's cleared on their books, no favor
My one condition: no boss, no savior

[Chorus]
Not a favor, not a boss, not a yes
Slow money, clean hands, nothing less
Who holds the power, who holds the purse
I write the terms, for better or worse

[Bridge]
Can I take it from a friend
And keep the friendship to the end?
If he's the boss, I cross a line
If he's not, the weight is mine
The books were cleared before he spoke
So nothing owed, no debt, no yoke
Weigh it slow, the way I do
The terms are mine, so the choice is too

[Final Chorus]
Not a favor, not a boss, not a yes
Slow money, clean hands, nothing less
Who holds the power, who holds the purse
I write the terms, for better or worse

[Outro]
Back of the Lexus, my hand in his hand
The desert runs into the sea
Two kinds of ground, and I understand
Yes is a word that belongs to me
